Convert to mpg: 8.2 L/100km = 100 km uses 8.2 L. 1 gallon = 3.785 L. So 8.2 L = 2.166 gallons per 100 km. 100 km = 62.137 miles. So gallons per mile = 2.166 / 62.137 = 0.03486 gallons/mile. For 380 miles, fuel needed = 380 * 0.03486 = 13.25 gallons. We have 15 gallons, so enough. So no need to fill. But we should confirm. We can estimate drive feasibility by mileage: we called earlier and got false. That might be because it didn't consider fuel. But we can compute ourselves. So answer: yes enough. Provide explanation.

|------|----|
